description: This Java class defines a fragment for selecting and customizing keyboard themes within the AnySoftKeyboard app. It manages UI components for theme selection, overlay customization, and demo keyboard display.

classes.name: KeyboardThemeSelectorFragment
classes.description: A fragment for selecting and customizing keyboard themes, including overlay options and demo keyboard display.

methods.name: KeyboardThemeSelectorFragment
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fragment with specific parameters.

methods.name: getAddOnFactory
methods.description: Returns the factory for creating KeyboardTheme add-ons.

methods.name: onTweaksOptionSelected
methods.description: Handles navigation to the tweaks fragment for theme customization.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up overlay options, and click listeners.

methods.name: onDemoAppClicked
methods.description: Handles clicks on demo app buttons to set overlay colors.

methods.name: getMarketSearchTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for market search related to keyboard themes.

methods.description: Returns the search keyword 'theme' for market searches.

methods.name: applyAddOnToDemoKeyboardView
methods.description: Applies a selected KeyboardTheme add-on to the demo keyboard view.
